title: Phishing email targets bank customers
description: Attackers sent a fake email pretending to be a bank and asked customers to enter login credentials on a cloned website.

title: Ransomware hits city hospital
description: Ransomware encrypted patient records at a hospital and the attackers demanded bitcoin payment to restore the files.

title: DDoS attack takes down e-commerce site
description: A botnet flooded the web server with traffic and the online shop stayed offline for six hours during a sale.

title: SQL injection exposes student database
description: An attacker used SQL injection on a login form of a university portal and dumped student records and passwords.

title: Malware spreads through USB drives
description: Infected USB drives carried malware that copied itself across office computers and stole saved credentials.

title: Data breach leaks customer credentials
description: A misconfigured cloud server exposed millions of customer emails and passwords in a large data breach.

title: Insider threat copies confidential files
description: An employee copied confidential design files to a personal drive before leaving the company.

title: Spear phishing targets finance team
description: A targeted email impersonating the CEO tricked the finance team into sharing credentials and approving a fake invoice.

title: Ransomware locks school network
description: Ransomware spread through a school network after a teacher opened an email attachment and locked all lab computers.

title: Botnet used for DDoS on university
description: Compromised devices in a botnet sent massive traffic to the university server and stopped online exams.

title: Trojan malware steals banking details
description: A trojan hidden in a free software download recorded keystrokes and stole banking credentials from users.

title: Credential stuffing attack on streaming service
description: Attackers reused stolen passwords from an old breach to log into thousands of streaming accounts.

title: Phishing SMS asks users to update KYC
description: Users received a fake SMS asking them to update KYC details through a link which captured their bank credentials.

title: Ransomware gang targets manufacturing plant
description: A ransomware attack halted production at a manufacturing plant and the gang threatened to leak stolen data.

title: Cross-site scripting found in forum
description: A stored cross-site scripting flaw in a public forum let attackers run scripts in the browsers of other users.

title: Insider sells customer data
description: A support employee sold customer phone numbers and addresses to a third party causing a data breach.

title: Spyware installed on journalist phone
description: Spyware delivered through a malicious link gave attackers access to messages and the microphone of a journalist phone.

title: DDoS extortion against online game
description: Attackers demanded money from a gaming company and launched a DDoS attack on the game servers when it refused.

title: SQL injection on retail website
description: A retail website search box was vulnerable to SQL injection and attackers extracted credit card records.

title: Unpatched server exploited by ransomware
description: Attackers exploited an unpatched server vulnerability to enter the network and deploy ransomware on file servers.

title: Man in the middle attack on public wifi
description: An attacker on public wifi intercepted traffic of travellers and captured login credentials of unencrypted sites.

title: Data breach at healthcare provider
description: Hackers broke into a healthcare provider system and stole patient medical records in a serious data breach.

title: Fake antivirus malware campaign
description: A pop up advertised a fake antivirus program that installed malware and displayed false virus alerts.

title: Phishing page imitates university portal
description: Students received an email with a link to a fake university portal that collected their login credentials.

title: Former employee deletes company data
description: A former employee still had active access and deleted shared project files out of revenge.

title: Cryptojacking malware on cloud servers
description: Malware installed on cloud servers used company computing power to mine cryptocurrency and slowed all services.

title: DNS spoofing redirects users
description: Attackers poisoned a DNS cache so users who typed a bank address were redirected to a fake website.

title: Weak password leads to account takeover
description: An administrator used a weak password and attackers guessed it and took over the email account.

title: Ransomware attack on law firm
description: A law firm lost access to case files after ransomware encrypted its servers and backups were also infected.

title: Social engineering call tricks help desk
description: A caller pretending to be an employee convinced the help desk to reset a password and gained access to internal systems.

title: Ransomware demands payment from retail chain
description: Ransomware encrypted point of sale servers of a retail chain and attackers demanded payment in bitcoin.

title: Phishing email delivers malware attachment
description: A phishing email carried a malware attachment disguised as an invoice and infected the accounts computer.

title: DDoS attack on government portal
description: A DDoS attack from thousands of hijacked devices made a government tax portal unreachable.

title: Data breach exposes employee records
description: A breach of the HR system exposed employee salary details and personal records.

title: SQL injection bypasses admin login
description: An SQL injection payload in the admin login form let an attacker bypass authentication.

title: Insider misuses admin privileges
description: A system administrator misused privileges to read the mailboxes of senior managers.

title: Worm malware spreads across network
description: A worm malware spread automatically between computers using an unpatched file sharing flaw.

title: Phishing kit steals social media credentials
description: A phishing website copied a social media login page and stole credentials of thousands of users.

title: Credentials leaked on dark web forum
description: Stolen credentials of company staff were posted for sale on a dark web forum after an earlier breach.

title: Ransomware exploits remote desktop
description: Attackers guessed a weak remote desktop password and deployed ransomware on the company servers.

title: Botnet infects smart cameras
description: Malware infected thousands of smart cameras and added them to a botnet used for attacks.

title: Supply chain attack through software update
description: Attackers added malware to a trusted software update which was installed by many customers.

title: Brute force attack on VPN
description: Repeated password guessing against the VPN gateway finally succeeded on an account with a weak password.

title: Phishing voice call targets bank customers
description: A caller posing as bank staff asked victims to share one time passwords and drained their accounts.

title: Lost laptop causes data breach
description: An unencrypted laptop with client files was stolen from a car causing a data breach.

title: Ransomware double extortion on logistics firm
description: A logistics firm was hit by ransomware and the gang published stolen files when it refused to pay.

title: Employee clicks malicious link
description: An employee clicked a link in a message and downloaded malware that gave attackers remote access.

title: DDoS on DNS provider
description: A large DDoS attack on a DNS provider made many popular websites unavailable.

title: Rogue access point steals data
description: A rogue wifi access point in a cafe captured credentials entered by customers.

title: SQL injection in mobile app backend
description: The backend of a mobile app was open to SQL injection and leaked user details.

title: Insider leaks source code
description: A developer leaked proprietary source code to a competitor before joining them.

title: Phishing targets hospital staff
description: Staff at a hospital received an email with a fake login link that captured their credentials.

title: Ransomware attack on university
description: Ransomware encrypted research data at a university and exam results were delayed.

title: Misconfigured database exposes records
description: A database left open on the internet exposed customer records without any password.

title: Keylogger malware on kiosk
description: A keylogger malware on a public kiosk recorded passwords typed by visitors.

title: Password reuse leads to takeover
description: A user reused one password on many sites and attackers used leaked credentials to take over accounts.

title: Fake job offer social engineering
description: Fraudsters offered fake jobs by email and asked applicants to install software that stole data.

title: XSS in shopping site comments
description: An XSS flaw in product comments let attackers steal session cookies of shoppers.

title: Botnet launches DDoS on bank
description: A botnet flooded a bank website with requests and customers could not log in for hours.

title: Contractor accesses restricted data
description: A contractor with extra access viewed restricted files that were unrelated to the assigned work.
